Need a hand with Owner Note? Use Reminders for follow-ups, Sales & purchases for bills, and Settings to change language or appearance. Voice entry on the home screen lets you add credit and debit by speaking.
Owner Note is an AI business assistant for Indian shop owners — voice-first transactions, cash flow, billing, and insights. Built to keep day-to-day books simple on your phone.
We use your shop data only to run Owner Note on this device and our API — ledger, reminders, and sign-in. Open the full privacy policy for details. Exact map pins are never shown in group buying.
Reminders and important business alerts appear here as notifications. Daily voice check-in can speak a short summary at set times — turn it on in Settings.
